style: Bright, soft 3D cartoon animation for children, warm autumn colours, simple clean background, gentle camera movement, no text, no letters, no words on screen, no speech, only soft natural sound effects.

words.scene: The camera glides along the hallway of a big busy school building, passing through different rooms one after another: a science lab, a library, an art room and a kitchen, each with its own small team of cartoon people busy at their special job.

A long train of many colourful wooden blocks lined up in a row on a desk magically shrinks and squeezes together until only three small blocks are left, with a little sparkle, as a cartoon child smiles and nods.
